name: Bellanca
summary: Bellanca is defined by sleek lines and refined contrast. The seat is upholstered in imitation leather, offering both comfort and elegance, while the legs are finished in matte black gold powder with subtle metallic warmth. Elegant and understated, it brings a timeless European sensibility to contemporary living spaces. 55x58x80
